india_trends.summary: NSE’s Rs 22,561.57 crore IPO ranks as India’s second-largest, behind Hyundai Motor India. india_trends.title: Mauritius-based Soach Global to make 25 times return from NSE IPO
india_trends.summary: Mauritius-based Soach Global is set to make nearly 25 times returns on its decade-old NSE investment, with its 82.5 lakh shares now valued at up to Rs 1,472 crore at the IPO price band. The fund is selling 16.5 lakh shares, while retaining 66 lakh shares as a long-term investment.
